scenes.title: Light-leak flash
scenes.what: Warm orange/magenta light leak burns across a cut in the cold open.

scenes.title: Headline cold open
scenes.what: News-clip flash, then headlines pushed in fast with lime highlighter on 'Quantum'; light-leak burns between; ends on the host's reaction.
scenes.motion: ~0.3–0.6s per headline, push-in; light leak on cuts

scenes.title: Headline smash cut
scenes.what: Headline fragments slide past in extreme close-up, slight motion blur, pink/orange leaks.

scenes.title: Abstract quantum flashes
scenes.what: Particle wave field, liquid chrome, protein renders — 0.6s abstract stock CG beats.

scenes.title: HUGE* title
scenes.what: House title: HUGE on blue, mauve block extrude, teal HUGE*, asterisk pattern, '*if true', lime HUGE* on sage.

scenes.title: IBM headline with highlight
scenes.what: Car scene → white flash → EETimes article; push into the key sentence where a yellow/lime highlight marks 'world's largest superconducting quantum processor'.

scenes.title: Collage frames on dark
scenes.what: Photos of supercomputers sit in white-bordered frames on a near-black board with coral and plum squares as offset blocks; frames swap.
scenes.motion: Frames slide in with the squares offset and lagging 2–3f

scenes.title: Crew callouts + pill lower thirds
scenes.what: Lime block arrows point at crew; lower thirds in sentence case inside a dark rounded pill with a lime keyline and a little lime notch ('Nicole Menkart, Associate Producer').
scenes.motion: Arrows pop and bob; pill wipes on L→R
scenes.type: White bold sentence case in a dark pill

scenes.title: QUANTUM 101 — the game world
scenes.what: Video-game title 'QUANTUM 101 / PLAYER 1' (lime chunky 3D type); pause menu 'CHOOSE YOUR MATH LEVEL' with horse/car/boat cards; a low-poly island world in bright cyan sea; split-screen racers; a magnifier of characters at a bridge.
scenes.motion: Game UI pops; camera orbits the island; split-screen wipe
scenes.type: Chunky lime game-title type; game-menu UI

scenes.title: Computers through time
scenes.what: Island zooms into retro computers: CRT monitors on a desk in 3D, screens glitch between eras (Mac 'hello', Windows); then a low-poly city grows on the island.
scenes.motion: Push-in; datamosh glitches between screens; city builds up

scenes.title: Choose the boat
scenes.what: Menu card picks the boat; the boat sails off the island onto a blueprint 'MATHEMATICAL MAP' with UNDISCOVERED islands and a lime title pill.
scenes.motion: Cursor click; camera tilts down to map; boat moves along dotted route
scenes.type: Lime title pill; white caps map labels

scenes.title: Mathematical map
scenes.what: Top-down map; '?' islands labelled UNDISCOVERED pulse; route lines draw.

scenes.title: Mind blown
scenes.what: Archival 'mind blown' head shot composited with a particle explosion out of the skull.

scenes.title: BITS
scenes.what: 'BITS' in lime heavy caps with dark extrude; a purple polygon flips; 0 and 1 states with small labels.
scenes.motion: Word pops; object rotates; numbers swap

scenes.title: Waves and interference
scenes.what: 0|1 split; a white wave; wave sums labelled CONSTRUCTIVE (lime) / DESTRUCTIVE (blue); concentric ripples overlap.

scenes.title: Qubits vs bits
scenes.what: Interference dots; BITS (lime) on a binary card vs QUBITS (blue) on a wave card; quantum computer render with 'QUANTUM COMPUTERS CALCULATE THINGS VERY DIFFERENTLY' then 'IT MAKES THEM GOOD AT DIFFERENT THINGS'.
scenes.motion: Cards flip in; lines type in two colours

scenes.title: Simulating nature island
scenes.what: Map → an island with palm trees and a '?' sign that becomes 'SIMULATING NATURE' lime pill.
scenes.motion: Camera flies to island; sign swaps

scenes.title: Leaf → molecule magnifier
scenes.what: Leaf in a circle; two nested magnifier circles drill into cells then a molecule.
scenes.motion: Nested magnifier circles scale from lime dots

scenes.title: Polaroids + encryption island
scenes.what: Polaroid photos of the hosts drop in; island; low-poly cloud island with 'ENCRYPTION' lime pill; light leak.
scenes.motion: Polaroids drop with rotation; pill pops

scenes.title: Encryption headlines
scenes.what: Headlines with lime highlight on 'break encryption'; one pulls into huge type 'That's a problem' highlighted.

scenes.title: Light leak
scenes.what: Magenta leak flash.

scenes.title: Keyword over footage
scenes.what: 'RSA Encryption' in lime heavy sentence case pops beside the speaker.

scenes.title: Arms-race headlines
scenes.what: Headlines with lime highlights ('quantum computing arms race', 'RACE TO DEVELOP').

scenes.title: IBM roadmap
scenes.what: Light leak into IBM press release and roadmap image; headline text with orange highlight.

scenes.title: Computer = boat = submarine
scenes.what: Quantum computer '=' boat, then '=' submarine (sparkle lines); ocean depth layers 'Simulating Nature / Encryption / ??? / ???'.
scenes.motion: Objects pop with equals; layers scroll down
scenes.type: White bold labels on blue bands

scenes.title: New math unlocked
scenes.what: Island city with menu card; submarine dives into an underwater ruin; 'NEW MATH UNLOCKED' lime game toast.
scenes.motion: Dive camera; toast pops like an achievement

scenes.title: End card (sentence-case variant)
scenes.what: Sage HUGE* + credits on grey plates; 'SUBSCRIBE!' lime over host; coral-block 'To support Huge If True, please consider subscribing.' with lime arrows.
